Cyber Security

Layered protection: endpoint, email, data loss prevention, identity and 24/7 detection.

How we deliver it

We combine prevention and detection: endpoints, email, identity and data are each protected, and logs flow to a central view for investigation and response.

  1. Assess: risk review, configuration and identity audit
  2. Protect: endpoint, email and DLP controls
  3. Detect: SIEM and managed detection and response
  4. Respond: playbooks, containment and lessons learned

Outcomes

  • Fewer successful attacks
  • Faster detection and response
  • Sensitive data kept from leaving
